### dist/kernel/engine.d.ts
import { EventRing } from "./ring.js";
import { Ledger } from "./ledger.js";
import { Pool } from "./pool.js";
import { type Random } from "./random.js";
export declare const IDLE = 0, READ = 1, STEP = 2, RENDER = 3;
export interface System {
    read?(e: Engine): void;
    step?(e: Engine, dt: number): void;
    render?(e: Engine, alpha: number): void;
    pause?(e: Engine): void;
}
export interface EngineOptions {
    root?: Element | null;
    step?: number;
    maxSteps?: number;
    seed?: number;
    events?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    onError?: (error: unknown, engine: Engine) => void;
    settle?: number;
    fps?: number;
    pause?: {
        hidden?: boolean;
        offscreen?: boolean;
        editable?: boolean;
        reducedMotion?: boolean;
    };
}
export interface EngineStats {
    frames: number;
    steps: number;
    dropped: number;
    time: number;
    frameMs: {
        avg: number;
        max: number;
    };
    events: {
        size: number;
        cap: number;
        dropped: number;
    };
    pools: Record<string, {
        used: number;
        cap: number;
    }>;
    ledger: number;
    paused: string[];
}
export type Engine = ReturnType<typeof createEngine>;
export declare const scheduler: {
    readonly engines: number;
    readonly requests: number;
};
export declare function createEngine(o?: EngineOptions): {
    signal: AbortSignal;
    events: EventRing;
    ledger: Ledger;
    random: Random;
    root: Element | null;
    timing: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    dt: number;
    readonly time: number;
    readonly steps: number;
    readonly phase: number;
    readonly live: number;
    readonly running: boolean;
    readonly paused: string[];
    add<S extends System>(s: S): S;
    remove(s: System): void;
    pool<T>(name: string, cap: number, create: () => T): Pool<T>;
    start(): void;
    busy(sec?: number): void;
    wake(): void;
    stop(): void;
    frame(now: number): void;
    advance(sec: number): void;
    stats(): EngineStats;
    destroy(): void;
};

### dist/kernel/ring.d.ts
export interface FizEvent {
    type: string;
    a: number;
    b: number;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    v: number;
}
export declare class EventRing {
    readonly cap: number;
    size: number;
    dropped: number;
    private readonly s;
    constructor(cap?: number);
    emit(type: string, a?: number, b?: number, x?: number, y?: number, v?: number): boolean;
    at(i: number): FizEvent | undefined;
    clear(): void;
}

### dist/kernel/ledger.d.ts
type El = HTMLElement | SVGElement;
export declare class Ledger {
    private readonly t;
    private readonly m;
    private readonly a;
    private z?;
    private e;
    text(node: CharacterData, value: string): boolean;
    style(el: El, prop: string, value: string, priority?: string): boolean;
    unstyle(el: El, prop: string): boolean;
    attr(el: El, name: string, value: string | null): boolean;
    cls(el: El, name: string, on: boolean): boolean;
    add<N extends Node>(node: N): N;
    restore(close?: boolean): void;
    get size(): number;
}
export {};

### dist/kernel/pool.d.ts
export declare class Pool<T> {
    readonly cap: number;
    readonly items: T[];
    private readonly f;
    constructor(cap: number, create: () => T);
    get size(): number;
    acquire(): T | undefined;
    releaseAt(i: number): boolean;
    release(item: T): boolean;
    clear(): void;
}

export interface Random {
    (): number;
    state: number;
}
export declare function seeded(seed?: number): Random;
